notes.title: 0.3.1 Update Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] NERFED PAWN, pawn now can only attack and move in a plus shape
[*] Fully implemented sound effects for buttons and movement with a mute button
[*] Added classical music that plays in game, also with an optional mute button
[*] Better visual tracking of the host or client leaving the game, and connected clients in the lobby
[*] Added chat box during the match, in game notifications and player messages can be sent
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 0.3
notes.content:
Added new gamemode that uses cool downs instead of turns.
Added settings for gamerules.
